stories.title: Tanker disabled, crew missing after attacks north of Oman's Khasab
stories.summary: A tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz was hit twice north of Oman's Khasab, leaving it disabled with an engine-room fire and its crew unaccounted for, UKMTO said. It adds to security concerns in the world's most important oil-shipping chokepoint.

stories.title: Ukraine strikes Kerch bridge as Russia reports 1,336 drones downed
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones and missiles struck the Kerch bridge linking Crimea to Russia overnight, an operation Zelenskyy called 'unprecedented,' while Moscow said it intercepted 1,336 drones. The escalation comes days before a Trump-Putin-Xi summit in Shenzhen.

stories.title: United Airlines resolves 'widespread system outage' that delayed flights
stories.summary: United Airlines said it resolved a widespread system outage Monday that delayed departures, days after a faulty router prompted an FAA nationwide ground stop. It was the latest in a string of disruptions to US air travel and banking systems.

stories.title: Reuters: Chinese labs are distilling OpenAI models to train rivals
stories.summary: A Reuters review of 300-plus Chinese documents found distillation of US frontier model outputs, including OpenAI's o1 and GPT-4o, has moved into mainstream industrial use to train domestic models such as Qwen. The practice slips past US chip export curbs.

stories.title: Anthropic details how the Claude Code team approaches verification
stories.summary: Anthropic published a deep-dive on how its Claude Code team verifies the coding agent's work before trusting changes. The post lands as AI coding agents become central to developer workflows.

stories.title: Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC GPU with 50,000+ CUDA cores at SC26
stories.summary: Nvidia announced the Rubin HPC GPU at SC26, packing more than 50,000 CUDA cores, sparse-data acceleration and seventh-generation NVLink, with availability expected in 2028. It targets scientific computing and agentic AI workloads.

stories.title: Browns ride 6-4 start into bye week as passing-game questions linger
stories.summary: The Browns head into their bye at 6-4 after a comeback win over Houston, but Deshaun Watson hasn't thrown a touchdown pass in four straight games, a stretch in which Cleveland has still won three. Seven games remain in the AFC playoff race.

stories.title: Ohio State men's basketball pulls away from Prairie View A&M
stories.summary: Ohio State used a big second half to beat Prairie View A&M 86-59, keeping the Buckeyes rolling through the early non-conference slate.

stories.title: Ohio State women's soccer lands No. 1 seed in NCAA bracket
stories.summary: Ohio State earned a No. 1 seed in the NCAA women's soccer tournament, putting the Buckeyes' path to the College Cup through Columbus.

stories.title: Aston Martin reveals bespoke livery for Las Vegas Grand Prix
stories.summary: Aston Martin showcased a one-off livery it will run at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, continuing the team's tradition of special designs for the race weekend.

stories.title: F1 race week brings road closures to the Las Vegas Strip
stories.summary: Road closures along the Las Vegas Strip ramp up this week as the Grand Prix returns Thursday, with the circuit set to host tens of thousands of visitors each night.

stories.title: Columbus City Council weighs response as south-side camp faces clearing
stories.summary: As an unsheltered encampment in south Columbus faces clearing, city council is weighing how to address homelessness amid broader debate over shelter capacity and outreach.

stories.title: Columbus-area gas prices keep falling
stories.summary: Gas prices across the Columbus area continued to decline, extending a recent slide as crude costs ease and drivers see the lowest pump prices in weeks.

stories.title: Two in custody after 'targeted' Columbus homicide; four suspects named
stories.summary: Columbus police named four suspects and said two are in custody in what they described as a targeted homicide, with the investigation still active.
